scenario.title: Credit Card Management App
scenario.description:
A customer logs into the credit card application, selects an active credit card, temporarily blocks the card due to suspected loss or unauthorized use, verifies that the card status changes to blocked, and later unblocks the card.

Features to test
Feature	What to verify
Login	Valid/invalid login
Card Selection	Select the correct credit card
Card Status	Active/Blocked status
Temporary Block	Block card successfully
Unblock Card	Restore card to active status
Transactions	Transactions affected while card is blocked
Confirmation	Status and confirmation message

reference_cases.title: Login with valid credentials
reference_cases.preconditions: User has a registered account with valid username and password
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to login page
2. Enter valid username
3. Enter valid password
4. Click Login button
reference_cases.expected_result: User is successfully logged in and redirected to dashboard/home page

reference_cases.title: Login with invalid password
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to login page
2. Enter valid username
3. Enter incorrect password
4. Click Login button
reference_cases.expected_result: Login fails with error message 'Invalid username or password' or similar. User remains on login page

reference_cases.title: Login with empty credentials
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to login page
2. Leave username field blank
3. Leave password field blank
4. Click Login button
reference_cases.expected_result: Validation error displayed, login button disabled or form validation prevents submission

reference_cases.title: Select active credit card from card list
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and has at least one active credit card
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to credit cards section
2. View list of available credit cards
3. Click/select an active credit card
reference_cases.expected_result: Card details are displayed showing card number (masked), current status as 'Active', and available actions

reference_cases.title: Temporarily block an active credit card
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and has selected an active credit card
reference_cases.steps:
1. Click on 'Block Card' or 'Temporarily Block' option
2. Confirm the blocking action if confirmation dialog appears
3. Submit the block request
reference_cases.expected_result: Card status changes to 'Blocked' or 'Temporarily Blocked', success confirmation message displayed

reference_cases.title: Verify card status displays as blocked after blocking
reference_cases.preconditions: User has just blocked a credit card
reference_cases.steps:
1. Check the card status on the card details page
2. Navigate away and return to the card selection page
3. Check that the blocked card shows blocked status in the list
reference_cases.expected_result: Card status consistently shows as 'Blocked' or 'Temporarily Blocked' across all views

reference_cases.title: Unblock a temporarily blocked card
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and has a credit card in temporarily blocked status
reference_cases.steps:
1. Select the blocked credit card
2. Click on 'Unblock Card' option
3. Confirm the unblock action if prompted
4. Submit the request
reference_cases.expected_result: Card status changes back to 'Active', confirmation message displayed indicating successful unblock

reference_cases.title: Attempt transaction on a blocked card
reference_cases.preconditions: Credit card is in blocked status
reference_cases.steps:
1. Attempt to make a purchase or transaction using the blocked card
2. Complete the transaction flow
reference_cases.expected_result: Transaction is declined with appropriate message indicating card is blocked

reference_cases.title: Try to block an already blocked card
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and has a card already in blocked status
reference_cases.steps:
1. Select the blocked card
2. Look for 'Block Card' option or try to access it
reference_cases.expected_result: Block option should be disabled/grayed out or not available. If available, should show message that card is already blocked

reference_cases.title: Try to unblock a card that is already active
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and has selected an active credit card
reference_cases.steps:
1. Look for 'Unblock Card' option on an active card
2. Attempt to access unblock functionality
reference_cases.expected_result: Unblock option should not be visible or should be disabled for active cards

reference_cases.title: Block card without confirmation
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and viewing an active card with block option available
reference_cases.steps:
1. Click 'Block Card' button
2. If confirmation dialog appears, click Cancel or close the dialog
3. Check card status
reference_cases.expected_result: Card remains in Active status, blocking action is cancelled

reference_cases.title: Verify confirmation message after successful block
reference_cases.preconditions: User is about to block an active card
reference_cases.steps:
1. Select active card
2. Click Block Card
3. Confirm the action
4. Observe the confirmation message
reference_cases.expected_result: Clear confirmation message displayed (e.g., 'Your card ending in XXXX has been temporarily blocked') with relevant details

reference_cases.title: Verify confirmation message after successful unblock
reference_cases.preconditions: User has a blocked card ready to unblock
reference_cases.steps:
1. Select blocked card
2. Click Unblock Card
3. Confirm the action
4. Read the confirmation message
reference_cases.expected_result: Confirmation message indicates card is now active again with card details shown

reference_cases.title: Select correct card when multiple cards exist
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in and has multiple credit cards (at least 3)
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to cards list
2. Identify cards by last 4 digits or card name
3. Select a specific card
4. Verify the card details match the selection
reference_cases.expected_result: The correct card is displayed with matching last 4 digits, expiry date, and card type

reference_cases.title: Session timeout during block operation
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in with a session timeout setting
reference_cases.steps:
1. Select an active card
2. Wait for session to timeout or manually expire session
3. Try to block the card
reference_cases.expected_result: User is redirected to login page or shown session expired message. Block operation should not complete

reference_cases.title: Check blocked card persistence after logout and login
reference_cases.preconditions: User has blocked a card in current session
reference_cases.steps:
1. Block a credit card successfully
2. Logout from the application
3. Login again with same credentials
4. Navigate to credit cards and check the previously blocked card status
reference_cases.expected_result: Card status remains 'Blocked' and persists across sessions

reference_cases.title: Rapid block and unblock actions
reference_cases.preconditions: User is logged in with an active card
reference_cases.steps:
1. Block the card
2. Immediately unblock the card
3. Block again
4. Unblock again
5. Check final status
reference_cases.expected_result: System handles rapid state changes correctly, final status is Active, no errors or inconsistent states

reference_cases.title: User with no credit cards
reference_cases.preconditions: User account exists but has no credit cards linked
reference_cases.steps:
1. Login successfully
2. Navigate to credit cards section
reference_cases.expected_result: Appropriate message displayed like 'No credit cards found' or 'Add a credit card', no errors

reference_cases.title: Login with SQL injection attempt
reference_cases.steps:
1. Navigate to login page
2. Enter SQL injection string in username (e.g., ' OR '1'='1)
3. Enter any password
4. Attempt login
reference_cases.expected_result: Login fails, no SQL error exposed, input is sanitized or rejected

helpers.name: setup
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Resets session to logged out state, clears current page to Login, clears any visible message, resets all card statuses to their initial values (cards 101 and 102 to Active, card 103 to Blocked), deletes all transactions created during tests

helpers.name: teardown
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: If id is provided and is a transaction id, deletes that transaction. If id is a card id, resets that card's status to its initial value. If id is None, does nothing (setup handles full cleanup)

helpers.name: current_page
helpers.returns: String: current page name ('Login', 'Dashboard', 'Card List', or 'Card Details')
helpers.behaviour: Returns the name of the page currently displayed to the user

helpers.name: visible_message
helpers.returns: String: the current message shown to user, or empty string if no message
helpers.behaviour: Returns the most recent feedback message displayed on screen (success, error, or info message)

helpers.name: navigate_to_login
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Opens the Login page, clears any session, clears visible message

helpers.name: fill_login_form
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Fills the username and password fields on the Login page. Does nothing if not on Login page

helpers.name: click_login
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if login succeeded, false otherwise
helpers.behaviour: Submits login form. If both fields empty, sets message 'Username and password are required' and returns false. If credentials match a user, logs in, navigates to Dashboard, clears message, returns true. Otherwise sets message 'Invalid username or password' and returns false. Must be on Login page

helpers.name: click_logout
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Logs out current user, navigates to Login page, clears message

helpers.name: navigate_to_cards
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if navigation succeeded, false if not logged in
helpers.behaviour: If logged in, navigates to Card List page and returns true. If not logged in, sets message 'Session expired. Please login again.', navigates to Login page, returns false

helpers.name: get_card_list
helpers.returns: List of objects: [{'id': int, 'last_four': string, 'card_type': string, 'status': string}, ...] or empty list
helpers.behaviour: Returns list of cards for logged-in user visible on Card List page. Each object has id, last_four, card_type, and status. Returns empty list if not logged in or user has no cards. Must be on Card List page

helpers.name: select_card
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if card selected successfully, false otherwise
helpers.behaviour: Selects card by id from Card List. If not logged in, sets message 'Session expired. Please login again.', navigates to Login, returns false. If card doesn't belong to user, sets message 'Card not found', returns false. Otherwise navigates to Card Details page for that card, clears message, returns true. Must be on Card List page

helpers.name: get_card_details
helpers.returns: Object: {'id': int, 'last_four': string, 'card_type': string, 'expiry_date': string, 'status': string} or None
helpers.behaviour: Returns details of currently selected card shown on Card Details page. Returns None if not on Card Details page or no card selected

helpers.name: is_block_button_visible
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if Block Card button is visible and enabled
helpers.behaviour: Returns true if on Card Details page and current card status is Active. Returns false otherwise

helpers.name: is_unblock_button_visible
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if Unblock Card button is visible and enabled
helpers.behaviour: Returns true if on Card Details page and current card status is Blocked. Returns false otherwise

helpers.name: click_block_card
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if block dialog opened, false otherwise
helpers.behaviour: If on Card Details page and card is Active, opens confirmation dialog and returns true. If card is already Blocked, sets message 'Card is already blocked' and returns false. If not logged in, sets message 'Session expired. Please login again.', navigates to Login, returns false

helpers.name: confirm_block
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if block succeeded
helpers.behaviour: Confirms block action in dialog. Changes card status to Blocked, sets message 'Your card ending in XXXX has been temporarily blocked' (with actual last 4 digits), closes dialog, returns true. Must have block dialog open

helpers.name: cancel_block
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Cancels block action, closes dialog without changing card status, clears message

helpers.name: click_unblock_card
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if unblock dialog opened, false otherwise
helpers.behaviour: If on Card Details page and card is Blocked, opens confirmation dialog and returns true. If card is already Active, sets message 'Card is already active' and returns false. If not logged in, sets message 'Session expired. Please login again.', navigates to Login, returns false

helpers.name: confirm_unblock
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if unblock succeeded
helpers.behaviour: Confirms unblock action in dialog. Changes card status to Active, sets message 'Your card ending in XXXX is now active' (with actual last 4 digits), closes dialog, returns true. Must have unblock dialog open

helpers.name: cancel_unblock
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Cancels unblock action, closes dialog without changing card status, clears message

helpers.name: attempt_transaction
helpers.returns: Object: {'success': boolean, 'message': string, 'transaction_id': int or None}
helpers.behaviour: Simulates a transaction attempt. If card status is Blocked, returns {'success': false, 'message': 'Transaction declined - card is blocked', 'transaction_id': None} and sets visible message to same. If card status is Active, creates transaction record, returns {'success': true, 'message': 'Transaction approved', 'transaction_id': <new_id>} and sets visible message. If card not found, returns {'success': false, 'message': 'Card not found', 'transaction_id': None}

helpers.name: api_login
helpers.returns: Object: {'ok': boolean, 'error': string or None, 'user_id': int or None}
helpers.behaviour: Authenticates user. If both fields empty, returns {'ok': false, 'error': 'Username and password are required', 'user_id': None}. If credentials match, returns {'ok': true, 'error': None, 'user_id': <id>} and establishes session. Otherwise returns {'ok': false, 'error': 'Invalid username or password', 'user_id': None}. Input is sanitized against SQL injection

helpers.name: api_logout
helpers.returns: Object: {'ok': boolean}
helpers.behaviour: Logs out current user, clears session. Always returns {'ok': true}

helpers.name: api_get_cards
helpers.returns: Object: {'ok': boolean, 'error': string or None, 'cards': list}
helpers.behaviour: Returns cards for user. If user_id is None or user not found, returns {'ok': false, 'error': 'User not found', 'cards': []}. Otherwise returns {'ok': true, 'error': None, 'cards': [{'id': int, 'last_four': string, 'card_type': string, 'expiry_date': string, 'status': string}, ...]}

helpers.name: api_get_card
helpers.returns: Object: {'ok': boolean, 'error': string or None, 'card': object or None}
helpers.behaviour: Returns single card details. If card not found or doesn't belong to user, returns {'ok': false, 'error': 'Card not found', 'card': None}. Otherwise returns {'ok': true, 'error': None, 'card': {'id': int, 'last_four': string, 'card_type': string, 'expiry_date': string, 'status': string}}

helpers.name: api_block_card
helpers.returns: Object: {'ok': boolean, 'error': string or None, 'message': string or None}
helpers.behaviour: Blocks a card. If card not found or doesn't belong to user, returns {'ok': false, 'error': 'Card not found', 'message': None}. If card already Blocked, returns {'ok': false, 'error': 'Card is already blocked', 'message': None}. Otherwise changes status to Blocked and returns {'ok': true, 'error': None, 'message': 'Your card ending in XXXX has been temporarily blocked'}

helpers.name: api_unblock_card
helpers.returns: Object: {'ok': boolean, 'error': string or None, 'message': string or None}
helpers.behaviour: Unblocks a card. If card not found or doesn't belong to user, returns {'ok': false, 'error': 'Card not found', 'message': None}. If card already Active, returns {'ok': false, 'error': 'Card is already active', 'message': None}. Otherwise changes status to Active and returns {'ok': true, 'error': None, 'message': 'Your card ending in XXXX is now active'}

helpers.name: api_process_transaction
helpers.returns: Object: {'ok': boolean, 'error': string or None, 'transaction_id': int or None}
helpers.behaviour: Processes a transaction. If card not found, returns {'ok': false, 'error': 'Card not found', 'transaction_id': None}. If card is Blocked, returns {'ok': false, 'error': 'Transaction declined - card is blocked', 'transaction_id': None}. If card is Active, creates transaction record and returns {'ok': true, 'error': None, 'transaction_id': <new_id>}

helpers.name: db_get_user
helpers.returns: Object: {'id': int, 'email': string, 'name': string} or None
helpers.behaviour: Returns user record by email, or None if not found

helpers.name: db_get_card
helpers.returns: Object: {'id': int, 'user_id': int, 'card_number': string, 'last_four': string, 'card_type': string, 'expiry_date': string, 'status': string} or None
helpers.behaviour: Returns card record by id, or None if not found

helpers.name: db_get_cards_for_user
helpers.returns: List of objects: [{'id': int, 'user_id': int, 'card_number': string, 'last_four': string, 'card_type': string, 'expiry_date': string, 'status': string}, ...]
helpers.behaviour: Returns all card records for a user, or empty list if none found

helpers.name: db_update_card_status
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if updated, false if card not found
helpers.behaviour: Updates card status to 'Active' or 'Blocked'. Returns true if card exists and was updated, false otherwise

helpers.name: db_get_transaction
helpers.returns: Object: {'id': int, 'card_id': int, 'amount': float, 'status': string, 'timestamp': string} or None
helpers.behaviour: Returns transaction record by id, or None if not found

helpers.name: db_get_transactions_for_card
helpers.returns: List of objects: [{'id': int, 'card_id': int, 'amount': float, 'status': string, 'timestamp': string}, ...]
helpers.behaviour: Returns all transaction records for a card, or empty list if none found

helpers.name: db_create_transaction
helpers.returns: Integer: new transaction id
helpers.behaviour: Creates a new transaction record with timestamp '2024-01-15 10:30:00' (fixed), returns the new id

helpers.name: db_delete_transaction
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if deleted, false if not found
helpers.behaviour: Deletes transaction record by id. Returns true if existed and was deleted, false otherwise

helpers.name: db_reset_card_status
helpers.returns: Boolean: true if reset, false if card not found
helpers.behaviour: Resets card status to its initial value (Active for cards 101 and 102, Blocked for card 103). Returns true if card exists, false otherwise

helpers.name: db_delete_all_transactions
helpers.returns: None
helpers.behaviour: Deletes all transaction records from the database

rules: Users must log in with valid email and password to access the application
Empty username or password fields prevent login with validation message
Invalid credentials show 'Invalid username or password' message
SQL injection attempts in login are sanitized and treated as invalid credentials
Only logged-in users can view their credit cards
Users can only see and manage their own credit cards
Card status can be either 'Active' or 'Blocked'
Block Card button is only visible and enabled when card status is Active
Unblock Card button is only visible and enabled when card status is Blocked
Blocking a card requires confirmation via dialog
Unblocking a card requires confirmation via dialog
Canceling block or unblock dialog leaves card status unchanged
Attempting to block an already blocked card shows error message without opening dialog
Attempting to unblock an already active card shows error message without opening dialog
Transactions on blocked cards are declined with specific message
Transactions on active cards are approved and recorded
Card status persists across logout and login sessions
Session expiration during operations redirects to login page
Users with no credit cards see empty card list
Card details show masked card number via last 4 digits, card type, expiry date, and status
All timestamps for transactions use fixed date 2024-01-15 10:30:00

not_supported: Real session timeout mechanism - tests must manually simulate session expiration by calling logout or checking session state
Actual network calls or external payment processing - transactions are simulated in-memory
Real-time clock - all timestamps use fixed date 2024-01-15 10:30:00
Password hashing - passwords stored and compared as plain text for simplicity
Card number masking in display - full card numbers stored but only last_four shown in UI
Multiple simultaneous sessions - single session state tracked
